llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了TiC/Ti6Al4V复合材料的选择性激光熔化工艺，其力学性能优化结果可为生物医用植入体材料设计提供借鉴。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address porous structures for stress shielding mitigation, fatigue behavior, surface roughness, or osseointegration, which are core to biomedical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较TiC/Ti6Al4V复合材料和Ti6Al4V在SLM下的工艺-结构-性能关系。
summary_zh.method: 使用选择性激光熔化制备样品，进行微观结构和力学性能表征。
summary_zh.result: TiC添加提高了强度，但需平衡延展性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、EBSD和拉伸测试验证微观结构和力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the process-structure-property relationships of TiC/Ti6Al4V composite and Ti6Al4V fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate samples, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: TiC addition enhanced strength but required a trade-off with ductility.
summary_en.validation: Microstructure and mechanical properties were validated via SEM, EBSD, and tensile testing.

papers.title: The effect of process parameters and scanning strategies on surface roughness of stainless steel 316L SLM parts
papers.abstract: Selective Laser Melting (SLM) process is a powder-based metal Additive Manufacturing (AM) technique that can generate fully functional and geometrically complex shapes which can be used in actual load-bearing situations. The mechanical properties of SLM parts are highly dependent on process parameters. Generally, the as-built surface quality of SLM parts is not good enough, and finding the optimum values of the parameters to improve surface quality is an ongoing challenge. In this study, an experimental approach was taken to investigate the effect of process parameters and scanning strategy on the surface roughness of stainless steel 316L parts as well as determine the optimal values of parameters and optimum scanning strategy. Laser profilometry was applied to measure surface roughness. Results showed that the scanning speed was the most effective parameter; increasing it from 900 mm/s to 1200 mm/s caused 62.5% rougher surfaces. Also, increasing laser power from 255 W to 300 W resulted in 41.8% rougher surfaces. Smaller hatch spaces caused better surface quality; decreasing it from 0.1 mm to 0.04 mm improved surface quality by 16%. And lower scan pattern angles resulted in slightly rougher surfaces (by 2%). Changing the settings from minimum overlap to maximum overlap resulted in 73.6% better surface quality. It was found that insufficient melting is the main reason for poor surface quality. Surface quality was improved whenever the resultant effect of parameters caused sufficient melting conditions. The optimum values were found as 270 W laser power, 900 mm/s scanning speed, 0.06 mm hatch spacing and 75° scan pattern angle. The best surface quality was obtained for the chessboard scanning strategy, with scan vectors being parallel to each other in adjacent blocks and rotating by 90° in successive layers. The optimum strategy caused 2.5 times better surface quality than the strategy of the roughest sample.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM工艺参数对不锈钢表面粗糙度的影响，未涉及生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能，仅作为增材制造背景参考。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on surface roughness optimization of stainless steel 316L without any biomedical context, porous structure design, stress shielding analysis, fatigue testing, or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 寻找SLM工艺参数优化表面粗糙度的最优值及扫描策略。
summary_zh.method: 实验测量不同激光功率、扫描速度、 hatch间距和扫描模式下的表面粗糙度。
summary_zh.result: 扫描速度影响最大，最优参数组合使表面质量提升2.5倍。
summary_zh.validation: 激光轮廓仪测量表面粗糙度，对比不同参数组合。

summary_en.motivation: To identify optimal SLM process parameters and scanning strategies for minimizing surface roughness in stainless steel 316L parts.
summary_en.method: Systematic experimental study varying laser power, scanning speed, hatch spacing, and scan pattern angles, measuring surface roughness with laser profilometry.
summary_en.result: Scanning speed is the most influential factor; optimal parameters (270 W, 900 mm/s, 0.06 mm hatch, 75° angle) with chessboard strategy yield 2.5× better surface quality.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurement of surface roughness via laser profilometry across different parameter combinations.
